title: Adjunction determinant and base change for a flat local complete intersection
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) and $p:W\to S$ a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] finitely presented (locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]) morphism whose nonempty geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are pure of dimension $d\geq0$ (every irreducible component has dimension $d$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]). Assume that locally on $W$ and $S$ there is a factorization $U\xrightarrow{i}P\to S$ with $P$ open in $\mathbf A^n_S$ and $i$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal $I$ is locally generated by a regular sequence of length $c=n-d$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Write $C=I/I^2$ on $U$, $V=i^*\Omega^1_{P/S}$, and $K_i=(\bigwedge^c C)^\vee\otimes\bigwedge^n V$, where the superscript $\vee$ means $\mathcal Hom(-,\mathcal O_U)$ and $i^*$ is module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Relative differentials mean the sheaf associated on affine charts with the module of Kähler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]; exterior powers are sheafifications of the module exterior powers [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra]. These $K_i$ have canonical transition isomorphisms, independent of presentations and satisfying the cocycle condition, hence define an invertible module $K_{W/S}$ [def-sc-invertible-module] even if $W\to S$ is nonseparated. They admit canonical identifications $i_*K_i\cong\mathcal Ext^c_P(i_*\mathcal O_U,\Omega^n_{P/S})$ [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-ext]. On every separated open chart $U/S$, the complex $K_{W/S}|_U[d]$ is the relative dualizing complex: it is the object locally represented by $R\mathcal Hom_P(i_*\mathcal O_U,\Omega^n_{P/S}[n])$, regarded as a complex on $U$. For every scheme morphism $S'\to S$, with $W'=W\times_SS'$ and projection $g:W'\to W$, the base-changed presentations have the same adjunction construction and the resulting canonical isomorphism $g^*K_{W/S}\cong K_{W'/S'}$ is compatible with composition of base changes. On the smooth locus [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] this construction is canonically $\Omega^d_{W/S}$.
